entries.prompt: Create a production transparent fighting-game sprite atlas, EXACTLY 8 columns x 6 rows (48 complete drawings), 2048x1536 px; equal 256x256 cells, full figure completely inside every cell with transparent gutters, NO text/grid/background/ground-shadow/effects. Reference image supplies painted arcade game style and red/white costume, but CHANGE Oichi to a clearly adult slender woman age 25 with SLIM thighs and calves (athletic, not bulky), long black HIGH PONYTAIL tied with simple red ribbon and small gold hair ornament. White sleeveless top, red short pleated skirt, brown forearm bracers, white socks/red sandals. Opaque plain white briefs under skirt visible incidentally during athletic spinning kick, nonsexual gameplay framing. A Japanese curved longbow and quiver are strapped diagonally on back whenever not shooting; only ONE bow. Same adult character and same body size throughout all 48. Face generally right. Each row is eight distinctly hand-drawn fluid sequential full-body poses. Row1 walking full gait, alternating steps, ponytail follows momentum, bow on back. Row2 first light needle throw, prepare right hand then throw right and recover, bow on back. Row3 second needle throw using other hand with torso rotation then recover, bow on back. Row4 THIRD LIGHT SPINNING HIGH ROUNDHOUSE KICK: frame1 guard;2 pivot torso away from viewer;3 BACK VIEW turning with knee high;4 unwind into high kick;5 extended leg at head level to right;6 follow through rotation, sweeping extended leg;7 lower foot;8 guard facing right. The kick MUST visibly turn the torso front-back-front through the sequence, slender legs and flowing ponytail, bow remains secured on back. Row5 HEAVY BOW SHOT: reach back, unsling bow, bring it forward, draw arrow, draw string to cheek, RELEASE to right, lower bow, resling on back. Row6 second/heavier bow shot: larger poised stance, unsling, full draw, release, follow through, put bow on back. Row5/6 draw a clearly readable BOW AND BOWSTRING in hands, NOT punches. Feet in each cell share baseline y~230; normal standing body height~190 pixels. High kick fully contained. Correct anatomy two arms two legs, no duplicates. Maintain clean readable painted style. Real changes to silhouette every frame; not repeated static drawings.
